州.meaning: Kyūshū (southernmost of the four main islands of Japan)

低.meaning: low (rank, degree, value, content, quality, etc.)

移.meaning: to move (to another place or state)

谷.meaning: valley (with a river running through it)

効.meaning: statement of the efficacy of a medicine

久.meaning: a long time (since the last time)

帯.meaning: carrying (on one's person or in the hand)

則.meaning: to follow (a rule, precedent, style, etc.)

永.meaning: Nagata-chō (Japan's political center; equiv. of Downing Street)

寺.meaning: child who attended a temple school (Edo period)

依.meaning: object representative of a divine spirit

札.meaning: amulet or talisman issued by a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple

照.meaning: reference (e.g. to a dictionary, passage, footnotes)

奥.meaning: Ōshū (alternative name of the former Mutsu province)

刺.meaning: sashimi (raw sliced fish, shellfish or crustaceans)

涙.meaning: to have tears in one's eyes

拝.meaning: to assume the posture of praying

粒.meaning: large drop (of rain, sweat, tears, etc.)

挟.meaning: to hold between (e.g. one's fingers, chopsticks)
